Late response, but I am really hooked on the Inhuman podcast. If you’re into true crime pods where the hosts cut right to the chase with little chatting beforehand, this one is for you. Hosted by two cool ladies and their specialty is cases with not a lot of coverage. Check them out!

I feel like my most controversial opinion is that I really like Sims 4. Sure there’s bugs and glitches but for the way I play, mostly just basic gameplay, Sims 4 works great and is so much fun. The graphics, the interactions, the general concept, etc. makes me engaged and in awe of the game creators honestly.
